args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. Flagged: none. Cleared: all 8 (r01–r08).
- All 8 runs passed rigid-body invariance (1.076–1.695 vs 2.0 %/h) and closure (0.314–0.453 vs 1.0 px/h). r04, r05 and r06 also passed plane sections. r01–r03, r07 and r08 used the width-free ratio, so plane sections was not run for them.
- r02: its centre strain-rate (REGR) peak is 112.16 %/h, against a batch median of 53.28. Its peak position (421 µm) and growth-zone length (684 µm) match the batch. Its stride is 1, and its rigid-invariance value equals the other runs'. This looks like a faster root, not a rescaled time base.
- r06–r08: the largest flank difference sits at 84 µm instead of 295 µm, and the growth zone is 674 µm instead of 684 µm. The REGR peak and its position match the batch, and r06 passes plane sections, so this fits real curvature near the tip. The +0.093 width-free ratio in r07 and r08 lies in the same region. It is only 0.13 from the batch median; its z of 4.32 comes from the very small batch spread.
- With no runs flagged, there is no common pattern to report. The flank-difference position near the tip in r06–r08 is the one profile difference in this batch and is worth watching in later batches.
